description: Build matrix for one entry: per-job status (passing, failing, building, paused), platform, config, log URL, at (when the job finished on GitHub Actions; null while building or not fetched yet), started_at, seen_at (when our sync first saw this result), and a rollup with last_build_at (the newest job finish; null if none), seen_at, passing_platforms, failing_platforms, applies_cleanly and needs_rebase. needs_rebase true: the newest patch does not apply to master, and the builds are of the last version that did.
name: get_patch_build_history
